summary: Re-test after 401 bug fix (Bearer token via localStorage instead of httpOnly cookie only). Confirmed the fix works end-to-end: backend /api/auth/register and /api/auth/login return {user, token}; get_current_user accepts Authorization: Bearer <token>; frontend AppContext stores it in localStorage and injects it into axios defaults. Backend pytest suite: 19 passed, 1 skipped. Frontend UI: registered a fresh user, ran chat (real AI reply '8' for 5+3), text (real prose), image (real data:image/... 543KB), history (populated), reload persists session, upgrade to Pro sets credits=10000, language switcher rtl<->ltr. ZERO 401 responses observed on any authenticated /api/* call during the entire UI run. Also confirmed via Bearer-only python client (no cookies) that all AI endpoints work.
ai_feature_verdicts: chat send - pass - Bearer auth, real reply '8' to 5+3 via gpt-5.6-terra, no 401
text generate - pass - Bearer auth, 212-char result, no 401
image generate - pass - Bearer auth, data:image/... 543307 chars via gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview, no 401
critical_code_review_comments: get_current_user correctly falls back cookie -> Authorization: Bearer <token>. Good.
Login/register include the access token in the JSON body AND set httpOnly cookies (defense-in-depth for both same-origin and iframe scenarios). Good.
AppContext reads the token from localStorage at module load and sets axios default Authorization header before any request fires, so /auth/me on refresh works. Good.
Minor: axios.defaults.withCredentials=true is still set; harmless but no longer strictly required for auth to work. Can be removed if desired.

seed_data_creation: Two fresh users created; each ran 1 chat + 1 text + 1 image op; one upgraded to Pro.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bearer-token auth is fully working. No 401 issues remain. Backend + Frontend both green. If further iteration is needed, focus on edge cases (token expiry, cross-tab logout) rather than base auth.
rca of the issue: Original bug: inside the iframe preview, browsers block third-party cookies, so httpOnly access_token cookie was never sent -> get_current_user raised 401 on chat/text/image. Fix: return access token in login/register JSON body; frontend stores it in localStorage and sets axios Authorization: Bearer default; backend get_current_user already accepts Bearer header. Verified: 0 x 401 across full UI + Bearer-only python flow.
